summary: This 94-video English Speaking Course playlist covers comprehensive fluency transformation over 94 days. It includes pronunciation, tenses, modal verbs, conjunctions, conditionals, and sentence structures. Each phase builds on the previous one, culminating in advanced practice and full fluency kit.
detailed_answer:
Executive Curriculum Overview: The course aims to transform English speaking fluency in 94 days, suitable for beginners to advanced learners. It combines daily lessons, exercises, and live sessions.

Detailed Chronological Phase Breakdown:
Phase 1 (Days 1-10): Foundations, Pronunciation & Basic Vocabulary
Phase 2 (Days 11-25): Non-Action Simple Sentences & All 12 Tenses with 500+ Exercises
Phase 3 (Days 26-41): Modal Verbs, Semi-Mods & Conjunctions
Phase 4 (Days 42-55): Conditionals Types 0-3, Causative Verbs & Active/Passive Voice
Phase 5 (Days 56-72): Advanced Sentence Structures, Prepositions & Contractions
Phase 6 (Days 73-94): Sentence Correction Drills, 10-Day Spoken Dialogue Practice & Full Fluency Kit

Key Grammar Rules & Structures Taught: Pronunciation, 12 tenses, modal verbs, conditionals, active/passive voice, sentence structures, prepositions, contractions, and more.

Methodology & Teaching Strategies: Hindi-to-English explanations, daily repetition, whiteboard demos, live Q&A sessions, and progressive skill-building.

Expected Learning Outcomes: At Day 30 - Basic fluency, Day 60 - Intermediate proficiency, Day 94 - Advanced conversation skills and full fluency kit completion.
